Hang_ups.Name: Distressed
Hang_ups.Effect: You are often distracted by worries and concerns that may or may not be relevant to the current situation. When making an alertness test to gain a better understanding of potential dangers to others ↓1.

Hang_ups.Name: Earthspoiled
Hang_ups.Effect: You are excited by and attached to the cornucopia of beautiful treasures Earth and human culture have to offer you. When exposed to a gorgeous piece of Earth art or culture, your skill tests suffer ↓1.

Hang_ups.Name: Glacial
Hang_ups.Effect: Your personality is cold and uncharismatic, and you struggle to connect with others. Many consider you rude or hostile even when you're not. Take a ↓1 on all persuasion skill tests unless you're using the Truth specialty.

Hang_ups.Name: Idolizer
Hang_ups.Effect: You have something of a hero worship complex. The hero you cherish and follow might be one of your teammates. Or it might be one of the many heroes of the Cybertronian wars. Your will power is 9 + Smarts.

Hang_ups.Name: Impulsive
Hang_ups.Effect: You are reckless and rash. Taking that shot at a Decepticon when your mission is only reconnaissance. No matter the circumstances you never gain the bonus of surprise. Additionally you gain ↓1 on your first skill test after you roll initiative.

Hang_ups.Name: Mode attachment
Hang_ups.Effect: You are deeply attached to one of your modes. When you choose this hang up either your bot mode or one of your alt modes. When converting into that selected mode you must make a technology skill test when converting against a DIF equal to 10 + half your level (rounded up). If you fail, you cannot change forms that turn and the action is lost.

Hang_ups.Name: Skeptical
Hang_ups.Effect: You are an objective observer, and concepts such as hope and inspiration do not impact you. You gain no benefit when an ally uses Lend Assistance on you.

Hang_ups.Name: Subordinate
Hang_ups.Effect: You are most comfortable knowing your specific place in the chain of command, even if it is at the bottom. You often struggle to make your own decisions without receiving orders from a superior. Take ↓1 to any skill test not directly related to your mission as stated.

Hang_ups.Name: Treacherous
Hang_ups.FlavorText: You are untrustworthy, unreliable, and everyone knows it.
Hang_ups.Effect: You can never use the Lend Assistance action.

Hang_ups.Name: Vainglorious
Hang_ups.FlavorText: You are pompous and self-important, and your reputation and good looks take precedence over being effective (this does not necessarily mean you are ineffective).
Hang_ups.Effect: On your first turn, after you roll initiative, you must spend your standard action delivering a speech to your enemies or preening and chest thrusting.

Hang_ups.Name: Violent
Hang_ups.FlavorText: You are eager for war and seek to be the center of conflict.
Hang_ups.Effect: Any skill check you make in combat that is not explicitly related to said combat takes ↓1.

Hang_ups.Name: Whimsical
Hang_ups.FlavorText: You do not take anything seriously and like to focus on light-hearted fun and playing tricks on your friends.
Hang_ups.Effect: Whenever you make an infiltration skill test that is not just for fun, take ↓1.
